body.name: Simultaneous polynomial-moment confidence fiber
body.construction: For \(\zeta\in\mathcal O_{\ell,R}\), set \(\mathcal B_{\ell,R}(\zeta)=\{b:\exists\theta\in\Theta_{\ell,R},\ \Phi_{\ell,R}(\theta)=\zeta,\ \beta(\theta)=b\}\). Set \(\mathcal J_n=Q_n\cap\mathcal O_{\ell,R}\) and \(I_n=\bigcup_{\zeta\in\mathcal J_n}\mathcal B_{\ell,R}(\zeta)\), with the standard empty-union convention \(I_n=\varnothing\) when \(\mathcal J_n=\varnothing\).
